1: // game.js – Simple "Pixel Runner" endless runner
2: // Targets <canvas id="game"></canvas> present in the HTML.

4: (function () {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7: 
8:   // Audio setup using Web Audio API
9:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
10:   // Ensure audio context is resumed on first user interaction
11:   const resumeAudio = () => { audioCtx.state === 'suspended' && audioCtx.resume(); };
12:   window.addEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio);
13:   window.addEventListener('click', resumeAudio);
14: 
15:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
16:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
17:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
18:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
19:     osc.type = 'square';
20:     osc.connect(gain);
21:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
22:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
23:     osc.start();
24:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
25:   }
26: 
27:   // Set canvas size to match its displayed size
28:   function resize() {
29:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
30:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
31:   }
32:   resize();
33:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
34: 
35:   // Game constants
36:   const CLOUD_COUNT = 5;
37:   const CLOUD_SPEED = 0.5;
38:   const CLOUD_MIN_Y = 20;
39:   const CLOUD_MAX_Y = 80;
40:   const CLOUD_WIDTH = 50;
41:   const CLOUD_HEIGHT = 30;
42:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
43:   const JUMP_VELOCITY = -12;
44:   const PLAYER_SIZE = 20;
45:   const OBSTACLE_WIDTH = 20;
46:   const OBSTACLE_MIN_HEIGHT = 20;
47:   const OBSTACLE_MAX_HEIGHT = 60;
48:   const OBSTACLE_GAP = 200; // distance between spawns
49:   const SPEED = 3; // pixels per frame (background scroll)
50: 
51:   // Player state
52:   const player = {
53:     x: 50,
54:     y: 0,
55:     vy: 0,
56:     width: PLAYER_SIZE,
57:     height: PLAYER_SIZE,
58:     onGround: false,
59:   };
60: 
61:   // Obstacles array
62:   const obstacles = [];
63:   let lastObstacleX = canvas.width;
64: 
65:   // Cloud objects
66:   const clouds = [];
67:   for (let i = 0; i < CLOUD_COUNT; i++) {
68:     clouds.push({
69:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
70:       y: CLOUD_MIN_Y + Math.random() * (CLOUD_MAX_Y - CLOUD_MIN_Y),
71:       width: CLOUD_WIDTH,
72:       height: CLOUD_HEIGHT,
73:     });
74:   }
75: 
76:   // Score (distance travelled)
77:   let score = 0;
78:   let startTime = null;
79:   let gameOver = false;
80: 
81:   // Input handling – space or up arrow to jump
82:   function handleJump(e) {
83:     if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') {
84:       if (player.onGround) {
85:         player.vy = JUMP_VELOCITY;
86:         player.onGround = false;
87:         playTone(440, 0.1); // jump sound
88:       }
89:     }
90:   }
91:   window.addEventListener('keydown', handleJump);
92: 
93:   // Helper: collision detection (AABB)
94:   function collides(a, b) {
95:     return (
96:       a.x < b.x + b.width &&
97:       a.x + a.width > b.x &&
98:       a.y < b.y + b.height &&
99:       a.y + a.height > b.y
100:     );
101:   }
102: 
103:   // Spawn a new obstacle
104:   function addObstacle() {
105:     const height = OBSTACLE_MIN_HEIGHT + Math.random() * (OBSTACLE_MAX_HEIGHT - OBSTACLE_MIN_HEIGHT);
106:     obstacles.push({
107:       x: canvas.width,
108:       y: canvas.height - height,
109:       width: OBSTACLE_WIDTH,
110:       height,
111:     });
112:   }
113: 
114:   // Main game loop
115:   // Added background scroll offset for simple parallax
116:   let bgOffset = 0;
117:   // Cloud objects
118:   const clouds = [];
119:   // Initialize clouds once
120:   for (let i = 0; i < CLOUD_COUNT; i++) {
121:     clouds.push({
122:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
123:       y: CLOUD_MIN_Y + Math.random() * (CLOUD_MAX_Y - CLOUD_MIN_Y),
124:       width: CLOUD_WIDTH,
125:       height: CLOUD_HEIGHT,
126:     });
127:   }
128:   function update(timestamp) {
129:     if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
130:     const delta = timestamp - (startTime + score * 16.6667);
131:     // Clear canvas
132:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
133: 
134:     // Sky gradient background
135:     const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
136:     skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#87ceeb'); // light blue
137:     skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#b0e0e6'); // pale turquoise
138:     ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
139:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
140: 
141:     // Draw moving clouds
142:     for (let c of clouds) {
143:       c.x -= CLOUD_SPEED;
144:       if (c.x + c.width < 0) c.x = canvas.width;
145:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
146:       ctx.beginPath();
147:       ctx.ellipse(c.x + c.width / 2, c.y, c.width / 2, c.height / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
148:       ctx.fill();
149:     }
150: 
151:     // Simple parallax ground pattern
152:     bgOffset = (bgOffset + SPEED / 2) % canvas.width;
153:     ctx.fillStyle = '#654321'; // brown ground
154:     ctx.fillRect(0, canvas.height - 2, canvas.width, 2);
155:     // draw repeating rectangles as hills
156:     for (let i = -canvas.width; i < canvas.width * 2; i += 40) {
157:       ctx.fillStyle = '#556b2f';
158:       ctx.fillRect(i + bgOffset, canvas.height - 30, 30, 20);
159:     }
160: 
161:     // Update player physics
162:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
163:     player.y += player.vy;
164:     const groundY = canvas.height - player.height;
165:     if (player.y >= groundY) {
166:       player.y = groundY;
167:       player.vy = 0;
168:       player.onGround = true;
169:     }
170: 
171:     // Draw player as a simple pixel character
172:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
173:     // Body
174:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.width, player.height);
175:     // Head (smaller square on top)
176:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0';
177:     ctx.fillRect(player.x + 4, player.y - 8, 12, 8);
178:     // Eyes
179:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
180:     ctx.fillRect(player.x + 6, player.y - 6, 2, 2);
181:     ctx.fillRect(player.x + 12, player.y - 6, 2, 2);
182: 
183:     // Update obstacles
184:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
185:       const obs = obstacles[i];
186:       obs.x -= SPEED;
187:       // Draw obstacle with simple 3‑D effect
188:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(obs.x, obs.y, obs.x, obs.y + obs.height);
189:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff7f7f'); // lighter top
190:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#b22222'); // darker bottom
191:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
192:       ctx.fillRect(obs.x, obs.y, obs.width, obs.height);
193:       // optional top highlight
194:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
195:       ctx.fillRect(obs.x, obs.y, obs.width, 2);
196: 
197: 
198:       // Collision check
199:       if (collides(player, obs)) {
200:         playTone(150, 0.3); // collision sound
201:         gameOver = true;
202:       }
203: 
204:       // Remove off‑screen obstacles
205:       if (obs.x + obs.width < 0) {
206:         obstacles.splice(i, 1);
207:       }
208:     }
209: 
210:     // Spawn obstacles based on distance travelled
211:     if (lastObstacleX - player.x > OBSTACLE_GAP) {
212:       addObstacle();
213:       lastObstacleX = canvas.width;
214:     } else {
215:       lastObstacleX -= SPEED;
216:     }
217: 
218:     // Update score (distance travelled)
219:     score = Math.floor((timestamp - startTime) / 10);
220:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
221:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
222:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
223: 
224:     if (!gameOver) {
225:       requestAnimationFrame(update);
226:     } else {
227:       // Game over screen
228:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
229:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
230:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
231:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
232:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
233:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
234:       ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 20);
235:     }
236:   }
237: 
238:   // Start the loop
239:   requestAnimationFrame(update);
240: })();
